stories.title: Muere una persona y 18 resultan heridas en el incendio en una residencia en Pamplona

en.title: One person dies and 18 are injured in fire at nursing home in Pamplona
en.summary: A fire broke out at a residential facility in Pamplona, resulting in one death and 18 injuries. Police have arrested a woman suspected of being responsible for the fire.

stories.title: Un muerto y tres heridos en un tiroteo entre dos familias en Alzira (Valencia)

en.title: One dead and three injured in shooting between two families in Alzira, Valencia
en.summary: A shooting erupted between two families in Alzira, Valencia, leaving one person dead and three injured. Four men have been detained in connection with the incident.

stories.title: Detienen a una usuaria como presunta autora del incendio en una residencia de Pamplona en la que ha muerto una persona y otras 18 han resultado heridas

en.title: Woman arrested as suspected author of fire at nursing home in Pamplona in which one person died and 18 others were injured
en.summary: Police arrested a woman suspected of causing a fire at a Pamplona residence that killed one person and injured 18 others. The woman is hospitalized under police custody while investigators determine her responsibility.

stories.title: Un tiroteo entre familias se salda con un muerto, tres heridos y cuatro detenidos en Alzira

en.title: Shooting between families results in one dead, three injured and four arrested in Alzira
en.summary: A shooting between members of two rival families in Alzira's l'Alquerieta neighborhood left one man dead and three wounded. Four people were arrested in connection with the incident.

stories.title: Detenida una paciente por el incendio de la residencia psiquiátrica de Pamplona en el que ha muerto una mujer

en.title: Patient arrested over fire at psychiatric residence in Pamplona in which a woman died
en.summary: A fire at a psychiatric residence in Pamplona on Saturday night killed one person and injured 18 others. A female resident has been detained as the suspected cause of the fire, which forced the evacuation of about 50 patients.

stories.title: Un tiroteo entre dos clanes de etnia gitana en Alzira (Valencia) acaba con un muerto y cuatro detenidos de una misma familia

en.title: Shooting between two Roma clans in Alzira, Valencia, leaves one dead and four arrested from same family
en.summary: A confrontation between two Roma clans in a Valencia neighborhood resulted in one fatality and three additional injuries. Four members of the same family were arrested in connection with the incident.

stories.title: Ucrania lanza uno de sus mayores ataques sobre Moscú en el último día de elecciones rusas

en.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest attacks on Moscow on final day of Russian elections
en.summary: Ukraine conducted a significant offensive against Moscow during Russia's election period, with at least two deaths reported. Ukraine's leadership confirmed the operation while calling for an end to the conflict.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran se posiciona en su primer concierto tras el despido de Macklemore: “Lo que está sucediendo en Gaza es injustificable”

en.title: Ed Sheeran positions himself at first concert after Macklemore's dismissal: "What is happening in Gaza is unjustifiable"
en.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed the controversy surrounding a rapper's removal from his tour over Palestinian support statements during his concert performance.

stories.title: Berto Romero y Javier Ruiz Caldera, en el festival de San Sebastián: “La mejor ciencia ficción habla de cómo funciona nuestra sociedad”

en.title: Berto Romero and Javier Ruiz Caldera at San Sebastián festival: "The best science fiction speaks about how our society works"
en.summary: Actor and screenwriter Berto Romero and director Javier Ruiz Caldera are competing for the Golden Shell at the San Sebastián film festival with their film "Cinco minutos más," which explores the concept that actions have consequences.

stories.title: El Barça de Raphinha revienta a un enérgico Sevilla

en.title: Barça's Raphinha demolishes energetic Sevilla
en.summary: Raphinha scored a hat-trick to lead Barcelona's second-half comeback against Sevilla. Barcelona dominated the second half after Sevilla's strong first-half performance.

stories.title: Un divino Raphinha anota otro hat-trick y mantiene el ritmo del Barça ante un valiente Sevilla

en.title: Divine Raphinha scores another hat-trick and maintains Barcelona's pace against brave Sevilla
en.summary: Raphinha achieved his hat-trick with assists from Lamine, leading Barcelona's comeback against Sevilla. The Brazilian has scored 12 goals in seven matches this season.

stories.title: A Raphinha no hay quien le pare: el brasileño lidera al Barça en Sevilla con un hat-trick

en.title: Raphinha unstoppable: Brazilian leads Barcelona in Sevilla with hat-trick
en.summary: Raphinha scored all three goals as Barcelona came from behind to win, marking Livaković's debut in goal for the club. The Brazilian's performance proved decisive in the match.

stories.title: El presidente de EEUU dice que creará la 'Fuerza IA' y nombrará un 'zar' para dirigirla

en.title: The US president says he will create an 'AI Force' and appoint a 'czar' to lead it
en.summary: The US president announced plans to establish a new AI Force and designate a leader to oversee it.

stories.title: La inteligencia artificial destapa trabajos sin sentido que estaban ocultos

en.title: Artificial intelligence uncovers meaningless jobs that were hidden
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is revealing unnecessary tasks embedded within legitimate professions, eliminating busywork rather than eliminating essential jobs themselves.

stories.title: La demanda de alquiler se traslada de las capitales a ciudades más pequeñas

en.title: Rental demand shifts from capital cities to smaller towns
en.summary: Rental interest is moving away from major cities toward smaller municipalities with more affordable prices, such as Getafe near Madrid and Cornellà near Barcelona.

stories.title: Llega la nueva era de la guerra controlada con IA

en.title: A new era of controlled warfare with AI arrives
en.summary: The Ukraine conflict is accelerating military innovation with AI-controlled drones, shifting global military strategy toward automation while raising concerns about delegating lethal decisions to machines.

stories.title: ¿Podemos fiarnos de la nueva IA médica?

en.title: Can we trust the new medical AI?
en.summary: While artificial intelligence offers potential healthcare advances, lack of transparency in medical algorithms poses patient risks, prompting calls for real-world testing and independent oversight.
